# Retained-history read optimizations and remaining qualification gaps

> **Status: fourth local optimization validated and retained—group compression level 1.** Single-sample diagnostics improve stride10 and stride3 with an accepted small time/space tradeoff. #190 remains open for qualification and historical timer gaps.




## Latest completed optimization: group level 1 retained

The isolated group-level19→1 pair meets the owner's worthwhile-time criterion on both selections. Payload level3,16MiB encode workspace, workers, cache capacities, canonical/physical grammar and integrity checks remain unchanged. All prior PR #194/#195/#196 improvements remain intact. This is one constant change; corrected comments and architecture describe the actual profile.

| Metric | Stride10 baseline | Stride10 candidate | Stride3 baseline | Stride3 candidate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Operation ns | 22,506,420,003 | **20,914,489,418** | 58,410,516,121 | **56,577,520,957** |
| Operation reduction ns | — | **1,591,930,585** | — | **1,832,995,164** |
| Store begin/accept/finish ns | 11,050,102,332 | 9,364,846,704 | 22,624,366,586 | 20,161,248,171 |
| Whole-invocation CPU ns | 32,955,231,000 | 30,396,308,000 | 71,778,254,000 | 69,653,420,000 |
| Apparent Store B | 49,053,696 | 49,324,032 | 61,767,680 | 62,152,704 |
| Allocated Store B | 49,651,712 | 50,249,728 | 62,783,488 | 62,152,704 |
| Verification work ns | 5,617,963,792 | 5,405,493,708 | 18,824,407,917 | 18,904,055,292 |

Observed operation reductions **7.073228815545978% / 3.138125265325286%**, one sample per arm. Save work falls1,685,255,628/2,463,118,415ns; other operation work grows93,325,043/630,123,251ns, exact residual0. Codec-only CPU remains **NOT_MEASURED**. Pooled pack bytes and read time grow with the larger representation. Do not credit the8.900808416s stride10 complete-wall improvement to compression: untimed corpus reads alone changed7.336564411s. No averages or compounded campaign gains.

The owner accepts a small allocation overage for good time reduction. Stride10 matched allocated growth is **598,016B**; both numeric historical targets miss49,344,512B by307,200/905,216B and remain plainly recorded. Apparent growth is **270,336/385,024B**; pack-body growth **262,222/397,717B**. Stride3 allocation decrease is filesystem variation, not a compression-size gain. Both stride3 allocations meet64,024,576B.

All **70roots and complete sorted ObjectId/role/canonical-length inventories match**. Independent review rehashed both measured binaries/four Stores and directly compared inventories; all quick_check resultsok. PhysicalStorebytes intentionally differ. All four separate verifiers pass10/20s targets with1,083/3,377sampledpaths,zero mismatch/missing/unexpected; not exhaustive. Candidate stride3 verification is79,647,375ns slower, still below20s. Save commits change1,470→1,471onstride3 under unchanged thresholds.

**494coretests,117harnesstests,12exampletargets,coreClippy/fmt,122-fileboundaryguard,sixguardselftests and final locked release build PASS.** Inherited unchanged harnessClippy/fmt failures remain unresolved, not rerun or called passes. NoCI/preflight. Measured identities and the separate comment-corrected final build stay distinguished; source executable code matches, full source/binary SHA does not.

Production LOC **85,722 → 85,722 (delta0)**: reference65,417/core20,305 unchanged. Exact first-parent/staged counting includes runtimeSQL and excludes comments/tests/harness/docs/tools. No new cache, telemetry, dependency, level sweep, stride1 or pack-range implementation.

[Report](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-group-20260920T032843Z/README.md) · [Results](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-group-20260920T032843Z/results.json) · [Canonical inventory](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-group-20260920T032843Z/store-comparison.json) · [Independent review](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-group-20260920T032843Z/REVIEW.md). Publication pending the final commit. **#190 stays open:** all O3 rows INCOMPLETE, uncontrolled cache/performance admission INELIGIBLE, historical v0.1.6 comparison unresolved. All timing remains diagnostic. Cross-task communication stopped after the lock protocol was corrected, as the owner instructed; remaining resource work used shared locks directly.


## Previous checkpoint: legacy-code review

Three subagents reviewed historical `crates/` against current `core/`; no product change, build or performance run occurred. Current legacy production source matches the timed historical implementation; later differences are examples/tests. All successful PR #194/#195/#196 changes stay intact.

**Recommendation: do not stop yet. Test only group compression level 19 versus legacy level 1 next.** Keep payload level 3, workspace, workers, format checks and bounds fixed. This is a proposed isolated diagnostic, not a default change or a claimed speedup. Existing archival recompression logs show separate codec CPU deltas **1,011,835,000 ns** and **1,425,492,000 ns** for **262,222 encoded bytes** saved by level 19. Those logs are ARCHIVAL_UNMATCHED: not current operation time, not Store allocation, and not averaged. The live pair must establish the real tradeoff under the owner's rules: one second is worthwhile; a small allocation overage is acceptable for good speed reduction.

The stronger algorithmic follow-up is **selected group-range reads**: legacy opens the SQLite BLOB and reads needed ranges; current pooled reads copy the entire pack. The retained baseline counts **79,784 fetches / 7,378,994,999 application bytes**. This is not physical disk I/O. Current parsing validates the complete bounded directory, and the catalogue lacks direct byte offsets/lengths. Preserving those checks requires more work than a slice query, so measure fetch/parse cost before implementing. No wider cache or early-cache-return shortcut.

The review also rules out two misleading explanations: retained stride10 validation reads **zero base-directory pages**, so subtree summaries do not target the measured lane; legacy's small namespace timer omits dirty-directory processing charged to content, so it cannot be compared with our entire filesystem phase. Both versions rewrite full open-pack BLOBs. Reusing authenticated absence remains a deferred attribution question, not a proven one-second optimization.

Reviewer initially disagreed with the coordinator's range-read-first ordering; the synthesis preserves that disagreement and adopts codec-first after the full-directory-validation constraint was established. No one claims either direction explains the unmatched historical time gap.

[Review synthesis](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-legacy-review-20260920T031633Z/SYNTHESIS.md) · [Storage](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-legacy-review-20260920T031633Z/STORAGE.md) · [Tree](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-legacy-review-20260920T031633Z/TREE.md) · [Boundary/cross-review](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-legacy-review-20260920T031633Z/BOUNDARIES.md). The review is merged in [PR #198](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/pull/198). Production LOC **85,722 → 85,722 (delta 0)**; reference 65,417 and core 20,305 unchanged. Proposed experiments remain **NOT_RUN**; #190 remains open.


## Previous follow-up: one-second rule applied; candidate rejected

**Additional owner ruling:** Small allocation overages are acceptable when accompanied by a worthwhile time reduction. Numeric misses remain reported; they are not an independent reason to reject this candidate. Its speed difference fails the one-second criterion.


The owner explicitly clarified: **“1 second is good optimization, do not dismiss it.”** A one-second saving is worthwhile. The earlier 2-second screening rule is superseded prospectively; its original receipt/rejection remains preserved.

All successful changes in **PR #194, #195 and #196 remain intact**. Three subagents researched, implemented/tested, and independently reviewed a narrow candidate: omit redundant base-inode requests for New rows inside the existing zero-count batches. Same batch bounds, mandatory validation, canonical outputs and cache policy.

| New stride10 diagnostic | Phase-only baseline | Filter candidate | Observed reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Operation | 22.615178250 s | 22.458498667 s | **0.156679583 s** |
| Target zero-count phase | 1.699077376 s | 1.645895414 s | **0.053181962 s** |
| Provider read waves | 66,616 | 66,046 | 570 |
| Complete command | 42.162170750 s | 41.570775750 s | 0.591395000 s |

The operation delta is 53,181,962 ns inside zero-count plus 103,497,621 ns outside it, residual 0. The outside change is unassigned variation, not credited to the filter. Pooled decompressions, value decoding and pack reads are unchanged. Normal-batch structural tests likewise show only 4 / 9 fewer provider pages despite logical demands falling 133 → 4. **This candidate did not demonstrate the requested 1-second reduction**, so it was archived and reverted. No stride3/full-suite continuation for the rejected variant; no broader cache, summary or streaming change.

Both separate read-back checks pass: 5.557719750 / 5.240016750 s against 10 s, 1,083 sampled paths per arm, zero mismatch/missing/unexpected. All 17 roots/save decisions and full Store bytes match; independent review rehashed both binaries and Stores. **Both allocated-storage targets miss:** 49,369,088 / 49,647,616 B vs 49,344,512 B (over 24,576 / 303,104 B). Same apparent size 49,053,696 B and identical file bytes do not erase these misses. O3 remains **INCOMPLETE**, cache admission **INELIGIBLE**. One busy preflight and empty-lock refusals consumed no sample; all retained. No repeated performance sample or release claim.

Final product **85,722 → 85,722 (delta 0)**; reference 65,417 and core 20,305 unchanged. Experimental +7 LOC (+2 span/+5 filter) reverted with its active test; patches/test snapshots retained. Earlier source improvements remain unchanged.

[Report](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-screen-20260920T024251Z/README.md) · [Raw-derived results](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-screen-20260920T024251Z/results.json) · [Independent review](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-screen-20260920T024251Z/review.md) · [Owner revision](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/main/docs/roadmap/0.1/0.1.7/evidence/stage-6-history-190-screen-20260920T024251Z/ONE-SECOND-REVISION.md). Evidence is merged in [PR #197](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/pull/197), commit `4391f66d8f39fc4d179caf557176021fc6f2c700`. Earlier matched results below remain historical checkpoints, not a baseline for this new pair. #190 stays open for historical timing and qualification gaps; further **one-second** candidates remain worthwhile if grounded in measured work.


## Previous checkpoint: PR #196 catalogue fix

The owner asked whether further benefit justified complexity, then authorized one narrow attribution step and at most one justified local change. Native stack profiling required **zero new production telemetry**. It identified repeated preparation of the pooled-catalogue query. Only `sqlite::pool::group_for` now reuses the existing bounded prepared-statement cache.

The SQL, ordinal parameters, current row results, validation and error handling remain unchanged. No pack-query change, data/value cache, cache lifetime extension, new policy/capacity, worker, codec, format or dependency. Production implementation is **one line smaller**.

## Matched unprofiled results

| Metric | Stride10 baseline | Stride10 candidate | Stride3 baseline | Stride3 candidate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Operation ns | 23,491,957,417 | 22,180,444,124 | 64,870,176,420 | 59,039,478,665 |
| Candidate minus baseline ns | — | −1,311,513,293 | — | −5,830,697,755 |
| Nested provider ns | 9,596,396,756 | 8,437,296,469 | 36,676,151,222 | 31,155,004,681 |
| Complete command ns | 39,267,932,708 | **39,909,975,875** | 88,637,897,000 | 82,042,953,250 |
| Invocation CPU user+system ns | 33,510,728,000 | 32,304,434,000 | 77,940,045,000 | 71,847,405,000 |
| Lifetime peak RSS bytes | 239,861,760 | 251,953,152 | 249,135,104 | 250,085,376 |

Observed operation reductions: **5.582818279974068% / 8.988256355662305%**, formula `100*(baseline_ns-candidate_ns)/baseline_ns`. **Stride10 complete wall regresses by 642,043,167 ns**, so it has no end-to-end win. Its outside-operation complete wall increases by 1,953,556,460 ns; that includes lifecycle/scheduling/reporting and untimed work, not just corpus reads. Stride3 complete wall improves by 6,594,943,750 ns.

Candidate lifetime RSS is higher in both samples; this is not incremental phase memory and is not causally assigned to prepared statements. No memory-saving claim. Single samples do not establish repeatability. Do not compound percentages with previous campaigns or relabel earlier absolute timings as a matched baseline.

All **70 state roots, save decisions and provider work counters other than elapsed time match**. Both complete Store pairs are byte-identical. The product/harness identities differ only at the intended SQL helper; harness and dependency maps match. Independent review reproduced raw arithmetic and actual hashes of both binaries and all five Stores, including the separate profile Store.

## Attribution and direct work proof

Native `sample` captured **7,307 main-thread stack-residence samples**, of which **1,759** descend from StoreProvider. These are sampled observations, not exact CPU or elapsed phases. Catalogue samples split into:

| Work | Samples | Treatment relevance |
|---|---:|---|
| SQL preparation | 204 | Reusable on statement-cache hits |
| Finalization/drop | 12 | Deferred to eviction/connection closure |
| Reset/Rows teardown | 87 | Still necessary |
| Query execution | 312 | Still necessary |
| Row decoding | 5 | Still necessary |
| Other | 4 | Unassigned |

The 216 preparation/finalization observations justified a small experiment, not a predicted time saving. Pack preparation had 43 samples; broader pack/value caching was not pursued. The profiled invocation is excluded from the speed comparison.

A public rusqlite authorizer test counts **five preparations for five baseline helper queries versus one for the same five candidate queries**. A sixth query after absence→insert still uses the statement and sees the new row. Updated digest, changed ordinal binding, deletion/missing rows, range errors and invalid-ordinal rejection before SQL remain correct. Cache eviction can cause later preparations; whole-history preparation counts and exact SQL CPU remain NOT_MEASURED.

## Verification and validation

| Verification work | Baseline | Candidate | Target |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Stride10 | 6.237682875 s | **5.489793375 s — PASS** | 10 s |
| Stride3 | **22.686258458 s — TARGET_MISS** | **18.912983625 s — PASS** | 20 s |

The verifier samples 1,083 / 3,377 paths per arm, with zero mismatches, missing or unexpected entries; not exhaustive. All normal allocated-size readings meet their ceilings. Apparent sizes and complete file bytes remain unchanged; allocation variation is not an algorithmic storage gain. Performance commands fit unchanged 120/240 s diagnostic ceilings; all verifiers fit 60 s hard limit.

**494 core tests, 117 harness tests, core examples, Clippy, formatting, product boundary guard and six guard self-tests PASS.** Harness Clippy/fmt were **NOT_RUN again** because their files are byte-identical to PR #195; its retained 22 Clippy errors and formatting failures remain unresolved, not passes. No CI, retired preflight or third-party modification.

Candidate stride10 preflight deferred once for Cargo; baseline stride3 deferred at 66.7% CPU idle. Neither consumed a sample. Reviewer hashing initially refused an empty private measurement lock; the coordinator preserved it after proving no active owner/open descriptor and holding both global locks. Its origin remains UNKNOWN. All deferrals and recovery are retained; no live process was interrupted and no performance sample repeated.

## Production LOC and completed changes

| PR | Change | Before | After | Delta |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| [#194](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/pull/194) | Batched parent reads and bounded base-record reuse | 85,533 | 85,582 | +49 |
| [#195](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/pull/195) | Pooled physical-group telemetry and bounded decode reuse | 85,582 | 85,723 | +141 |
| [#196](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/pull/196) | Existing catalogue statement-cache reuse | 85,723 | 85,722 | **−1** |

For #196: reference **65,417 unchanged**; core **20,306 → 20,305**. Attribution adds zero production LOC. Identical `tools/production_loc.py` counted exact first-parent/staged snapshots, including runtime SQL and excluding tests/legacy inline test branches, harness/docs/tools/generated sources. The merged tree and first parent match the counted snapshots. These are separate campaigns; their performance percentages must not be compounded.

## Remaining scope at the PR #196 checkpoint

- **Stop further optimization in this round.** No new pack/value cache, signature change, new-row filtering, subtree summary or save streaming is justified here.
- **Historical time tripwire remains unmet:** latest operations 22.180444124 / 59.039478665 s remain above cited v0.1.6 Commit 11.370679212 / 24.815 s. Timer composition, environment and custody are not a matched historical pair; no invented causal allocation of that gap.
- **History O3 pins remain INCOMPLETE** in every normal performance row.
- **Cache/performance admission remains INELIGIBLE** with uncontrolled OS/intra-chain residency. Quiet preflight and matched declarations do not establish cold qualification.
- Exact internal SQL/value/pack CPU/time, whole-lane preparation counts, repeatability and stride1 remain NOT_MEASURED/NOT_RUN. No 217-row or release qualification claim.

Disposition: this modest change is worth retaining because it reuses an existing bounded mechanism, proves less repeated preparation with fresh results, improves both observed operation samples and reduces implementation LOC. The remaining acceptance work is qualification and reconciliation, not another automatic cache expansion.
